verdict.rationale: Deepgram explicitly documents a Model Improvement Program that requests participate in by default, but provides a per-request opt-out (mip_opt_out=true) that ensures opted-out data is not retained/used for training. This gives users a concrete mechanism to prevent their data from training models, though it requires manual per-request action rather than a default privacy-first stance. Missing for 10: account-wide/default opt-out setting, independent confirmation that opt-out is honored in practice, and clarity on retroactive data deletion.
